yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No absolute campaign date is spoken. June 30–July 1, 1748 comes from YAML; this relative-span match is conditional on that working start date.
yamlCheck.explanation: The covered play is the monastery arrival, dinner and overnight, then the following morning’s ruins expedition and return to the surface. The opening eleven-day travel is recap, corroborated by the dated Session 33 account, not eleven additional days played here. One completed overnight accounts for the YAML boundary. Spell durations, prior omens, planned trips and future crafting weeks do not extend this span.
